hooks.name: a11y-review
hooks.description: After the agent edits a UI component or stylesheet, asks it to check the change against the accessibility steering file.

action.prompt: You just edited a UI file. Check that file against .kiro/steering/accessibility.md: single-switch operability, 44px targets, visible focus, contrast in all three themes, reduced motion, the 3-flashes-per-second limit, accessible names and aria-live usage. Fix any violation now. Then add one line to your summary: 'a11y: OK' or 'a11y: fixed <what>' or 'a11y: could not fix <what>'.
